conpro_bad_ads.name: Bad News / ConPro Online Ads Dataset
conpro_bad_ads.access_requirements: Open GitHub repository for code and dataset.csv (2,246 ad annotations). Screenshots archive (~multi-GB) is hosted on Google Drive (link provided in README).
conpro_bad_ads.license_status: Research / Academic Use Only (ConPro 2020 publication; no explicit permissive open source license file)

hateful_memes.name: Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM)
hateful_memes.access_requirements: Restricted / Gated Access. Requires registering on DrivenData (Competition 73) or signing the Meta research license agreement via Hugging Face ('facebook/hateful_memes').
hateful_memes.license_status: Meta Hateful Memes Research License (Non-commercial research only, privacy restrictions, Getty Images compilation restrictions)

dehate.name: DeHate Video Dataset
dehate.access_requirements: Open GitHub repo contains DeHate.xlsx (6,689 annotated video entries). Video clips must be fetched via platform IDs or requested from authors in compliance with platform terms of service.
dehate.license_status: Academic Research Use Only (Strict Ethics Statement; confidential research use only; no permissive redistribution of raw platform videos)

jigsaw_toxic.name: Jigsaw Multilingual / Toxic Comment Classification
jigsaw_toxic.access_requirements: Kaggle account required to accept competition rules; also mirrored under TensorFlow Datasets and Hugging Face ('jigsaw_toxicity_pred').
jigsaw_toxic.license_status: CC0 (Public Domain) for Jigsaw annotations; underlying Wikipedia talk page comments licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0

utkface.name: UTKFace Large-Scale Face Dataset
utkface.access_requirements: Open Google Drive links provided in official GitHub repository README (1.3GB in-the-wild, 107MB cropped faces, 12MB landmarks).
utkface.license_status: Non-commercial Research Purposes Only (AICIP does not hold image copyright; collected from web).

fairface.name: FairFace Balanced Demographic Face Dataset
fairface.access_requirements: Public GitHub repository (dchen236/FairFace and joojs/fairface) with Google Drive download links for images (train/val archive) and label CSV files.
